summary: Tested new Broadcast Channels Configuration feature (backend + frontend). All 10 backend pytest cases pass (list, secret redaction in response, save with merge behavior, unknown channel 404, live-test error paths for telegram/email, missing-required 400, audit logging with secret redaction). Frontend UI verified: /broadcast page loads, 5 channel cards render with correct data-testid, Modify dialog on Telegram opens showing bot_token/chat_id/message_thread_id fields, Test connection triggers real Telegram getMe call and shows 'Connection failed - Unauthorized' inside dialog (broadcast-test-result), Save closes the dialog and card status transitions to Configured/Error accordingly. Data-testid coverage complete (broadcast-page, broadcast-card-{key}, broadcast-modify-{key}, broadcast-dialog, broadcast-field-{name}, broadcast-test-btn, broadcast-save-btn, broadcast-test-result).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 2334 lines — consider splitting broadcast module (BROADCAST_CHANNELS, testers, endpoints) into backend/broadcast.py router for maintainability.
Live SMTP test uses aiosmtplib/smtplib with a default 10s+ timeout; consider bounding test_broadcast_channel handler timeouts to avoid holding a worker if user picks a slow host.
Slack/Discord/Webhook testers post a real message to the configured URL when credentials look valid — document this so admins know Test connection is destructive (sends a real ping).
seed_data_creation: Test wrote sample configs into broadcast_configs for telegram/discord/slack/webhook/email with obviously-fake credentials. Leftover error-status docs are expected per request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_broadcast.py (10 tests). Feature is stable. Note tests hit live external endpoints (Telegram getMe, invalid SMTP host, invalid webhook URL) — expected to fail with graceful 'error' status. Audit log entity_type='broadcast' with actions 'configure'/'test' verified redaction of bot_token/webhook_url/url/header_value.
